releaseNotes: Audit Logs now visible — fixed Firestore path mismatch
Backup fully functional — document IDs now preserved
Notification Settings duplicate save button removed
Export data: each button has independent loading state
Payment methods now synced from Settings
Receipt watermark appears in shared/downloaded PDFs
Screenshot protection toggle in Security Settings
Membership ID shown in student profile header
Drag-to-reorder fields now works in Form Settings
Back button no longer closes app in Student Profile
Login screen shows org logo instantly from cache

studentFeatures.title: Official Fee Receipts with Org Watermark
studentFeatures.description: Shared PDF receipts now include your library's logo watermark exactly as shown in preview.

studentFeatures.title: Accurate Grace Period Tracking
studentFeatures.description: Membership expiry automation now honours your admin-configured grace period — no more resets.

studentFeatures.title: Screenshot Protection Control
studentFeatures.description: Your library admin can now control screenshot protection across the app for your privacy.

adminFeatures.title: Audit Logs — Now Working
adminFeatures.description: All admin actions are now correctly logged and visible in Admin → Audit Logs.

adminFeatures.title: Backup & Restore — Fully Fixed
adminFeatures.description: Backup now stores Firestore document IDs. Restore correctly writes back all data.

adminFeatures.title: Grace Period Respects Your Settings
adminFeatures.description: The automation engine reads your configured grace period, not a hardcoded default.

adminFeatures.title: Screenshot Protection Toggle
adminFeatures.description: New toggle in Security Settings to enable/disable screenshot protection globally.

adminFeatures.title: Field Reordering Fixed
adminFeatures.description: Drag-to-reorder in Form Fields and Payment Methods settings now works correctly.

adminFeatures.title: Membership ID in Student Profile
adminFeatures.description: Student membership ID is now shown in the profile header. Long-press to copy.
